comment: Segments listed here are planned again by tools/router.py. Every other segment keeps its current line. via points are [lng, lat], approximate: the router snaps each to the nearest rideable way within 200 m.

4.why: Follow the river and National Cycle Route 4 through Deptford: South Dock lock, Pepys Park, Deptford Strand, Sayes Court, Deptford Green, then the swing bridge at the mouth of Deptford Creek. Not Evelyn Street.

8.why: Prefer the riverside path up the west side of the Isle of Dogs wherever cycling is allowed, in place of Westferry Road.
8.keep_old_reason: The router finds no cycling riverside path on the west side. Its own best line leaves Westferry Road entirely for East Ferry Road, Marsh Wall and Millharbour in the middle of the island (3.7 km against 3.1 km, with a loop round the start). Both asides for this segment speak of 'this road' (Westferry Road), so the old line stays.

10.why: Stay by the river: Narrow Street, then through King Edward Memorial Park, not along The Highway.

11.why: See old Wapping: west along Wapping High Street, north up Wapping Lane, over The Highway into Cannon Street Road.
